title: Outer horn fillers along an equivalence
statement: Use horns and equivalence edges as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $Q$ be a quasicategory and $n\geq2$. Every map $\Lambda_0^n\to Q$ whose edge $[0,1]$ is an equivalence extends to $\Delta^n$. Every map $\Lambda_n^n\to Q$ whose edge $[n-1,n]$ is an equivalence also extends to $\Delta^n$. Conversely, an edge having either of these extension properties for every such horn is an equivalence.
